easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Hulking Metamorph.
description:
Cast Hulking Metamorph by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Hulking Metamorph enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Hulking Metamorph. Choose to have Hulking Metamorph enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.
